judgment.notes: H005 supplies the simultaneous integer/complex basis and U_Z-stability; D003 includes every X_r,Y_r. N001 applies at nonnegative indices λ, λ−i and λ−j because H001 and i,j∈I give their ranges. D007's H001 guard and D010's N001 basis guard are available. Routine basis, tensor and prime-divisibility facts are justified in BG001–BG003; there are no E/M applications.

S001 constructs R-coordinates on the tensor product, proving freeness and μ-injectivity by complex independence; its image spans V and stability extends by complex linearity. In S002, Q fixes e_λ and kills all other basis vectors. For each k∈I, QY_(λ−j)e_k vanishes unless k=j, where it equals binom(λ,j)e_λ; X_(λ−i)e_λ=e_i. Thus the S003 product is exactly E_ij.
